Since these shares have been extinguished after June 30, 2019, the same have not been excluded from the shareholding details.n n(d) After giving effect to the shares extinguished as on July 3, 2019, the paid-up share capital of the Company is INR 764,250,000 comprising of 76,425,000 Equity Shares of INR 10 each.n n(e) The Company has closed the Buyback w.e.f. name: Persistent Systems Limited
remarksWeb: The Board of Directors, in its meeting held in January 2019, approved the buyback by the Company of its fully paid-up equity shares having face value of INR 10 each at a price not exceeding INR 750 (INR Seven Hundred and Fifty only) per Equity Share ( Maximum Buyback Price ) and for an aggregate amount not exceeding INR 2,250 Million ( Maximum Buyback Size ), from the shareholders of the Company, payable in cash via the  open market  route through the stock exchanges under the SEBI (Buy-Back of Securities) Regulations, 2018 and the Companies Act, 2013 and other applicable rules.nnThe window for buying the shares opened on February 8, 2019 and the following shares have been purchased:nn(a) The Company purchased 368,851 equity shares under buyback till February 28, 2019 and extinguished these shares on March 13, 2019 after following the due process. Hence, the total equity shares as on March 31, 2019 stands at 79,631,149.nn(b) The Company has purchased 512,247 equity shares in March 2019 and extinguished the same on April 9, 2019 after following the due process. Since these shares have been extinguished after March 31, 2019, the same have not been excluded from the shareholding details.nnAfter giving effect to the shares extinguished as on April 9, 2019, the paid up share capital of the Company is INR 791,189,020 comprising of 79,118,902 Equity Shares of INR 10 each.nn
